title: HSK 1 · Stories
description: Fifty short first-reader stories built around the HSK 1 vocabulary.

sentences.en: I am a cat, and I don't have a name.
I live in a big school.
There are a lot of students at the school, and they all like me.
At noon I sleep on the table.
I am very happy.
There is a little dog at my house.
He is small, and pretty too.
He likes to eat rice and vegetables.
In the afternoon he and I are at home.
I love him very much.
My name is Xiao Yue.

tokens.en: to be called; to call out

sentences.en: Mom calls me Yueyue.

tokens.en: to be called; to call out

sentences.en: My friends call me Yueyue too.

tokens.en: to be called; to call out

sentences.en: I like my name a lot.
It's raining today and the weather is cold.
I don't want to go to school.
Mom spoke up: you're a student, please go to school.
I went to school, and the teacher was happy.
Dad has a car.
That car isn't big, and it isn't new either.
Dad says that car is very good.
On Sunday he drives and we go to Beijing.
My mom can cook.
Her food is very tasty.
Today at noon she made rice and fish.
I ate a lot and I was very happy.
Our teacher is Chinese.
She asks us to read and write characters.
My handwriting isn't pretty.
The teacher said: it doesn't matter, learning Chinese takes time.
There is an apple on the table.
That apple is big and pretty.
I want to eat that apple.
Mom said: that's dad's apple.
I didn't eat it.
I have a Chinese book.
That book isn't big and the characters are small.
I read for ten minutes every day.
Now I know a lot of characters.
My cat likes the chair.
She sleeps on the chair.
I want to sit on the chair, but she doesn't leave.
I sit on the table and read.

sentences.en: On Sunday morning I don't go to school.
I stay home watching TV and drinking tea.

tokens.en: to look at; to read; to watch

sentences.en: Dad works in the back room.
Mom is at the shop buying things.
It's nice at home.
Yesterday I didn't want to study.
I watched three hours of television.

tokens.en: to look at; to read; to watch

sentences.en: Today the teacher asked me to answer a question.
I couldn't answer.
Now I want to study.
Today there's a new classmate in our classroom.
He is a man, not tall, and very talkative.
He said he studies Chinese too.
At noon we ate together.
Now he's my friend.
Yesterday afternoon I went to see a film.

tokens.en: to look at; to read; to watch

sentences.en: In the film there's a little dog and a doctor.
That dog could really talk.
I liked that film a lot.
The weather is hot today.
I want to drink a lot of water.
Mom bought a big watermelon.
The watermelon was tasty and I ate some.
Now I'm not hot any more.
I have a small computer.
I write Chinese characters on the computer.
Yesterday my computer stopped working.
I asked a classmate to look at it, and he said it was fine.

tokens.en: to look at; to read; to watch

sentences.en: Today the computer is fine and I'm happy.
There's a cat and a dog at my house.
The cat is on the table and the dog is under it.
The cat doesn't like the dog.
The dog likes the cat a lot.
They are both my friends.
My dad is a doctor.
He works at the hospital every day.
He is busy and comes home tired.
I make him tea.
He says I'm a good kid.
My friend's name is Xiao Bai.

sentences.en: He lives in front of my house.
In the afternoon we run behind the school.
He runs fast.

sentences.en: I'm slow, but I'm happy too.
I have ten yuan.
I want to buy a book.
That book is twelve yuan; I'm two short.
I asked my older brother to help me.
He gave me two yuan.
There's a chair in my room.
That chair is old and it talks when you sit on it.
Dad says that chair is too old.
I don't want to buy a new one.
Last year mom and I went to Beijing.
Beijing is big and there are a lot of people.
We took a taxi to the shops.
I bought something for my little dog.
I love Beijing.
Today my teacher came to my house.
Mom offered her tea and fruit.
The teacher said our tea was very good.
She also said I'm a good student.
Mom was very happy.
I have a daughter; she is five.
She likes cats a lot.
Today she wrote one character at school.
That character was "cat".
I said: beautiful!
Yesterday mom bought a lot of apples.
Apples were on the table, on the chair, and on the TV.
I said: that's too many!
Mom said: invite your classmates to come eat them.
Now there are fewer apples and we're all happy.
We have a new Chinese teacher.
She is beautiful, and her handwriting is beautiful too.
We all like her class.
I think my Chinese is going to be good.
Today I rode in an airplane for the first time.
The plane is big and there are a lot of people.
On the plane I read and drank water.

tokens.en: to look at; to read; to watch

sentences.en: Three hours later I arrived in Beijing.
Today is my birthday.
I'm twenty.
Friends came to my house and we ate and drank tea.
Mom made really tasty rice.
I was very happy.
This morning I didn't see my cat.
I looked in the room — nothing.
I looked under the table — nothing either.
In the afternoon I saw her sleeping on the chair.
She was home the whole time.
Yesterday I wanted to cook.
I made rice and eggs.
The rice was good; the eggs weren't tasty.
Mom said: it doesn't matter, you'll learn.
Today my eggs were tasty.
It's eleven o'clock now.
I want to sleep, but my book is very good.

tokens.en: to look at; to read; to watch

sentences.en: I said: ten more minutes.

tokens.en: to look at; to read; to watch

sentences.en: Now it's twelve.
Tomorrow morning I'll be tired.
I have an older brother.
He's twenty-five and works at a company.
He's busy and I don't see him often.
On Sunday he comes to my house to eat.
We talked for a long time.
Our school has a cat.
He is black and big.
At noon he sleeps in front of the classroom.
The students all like him and all feed him.
Now he's too big.
I have a new phone.
I study Chinese on my phone.
Every day I study twenty new characters.
But I also watch films on my phone.

tokens.en: to look at; to read; to watch

sentences.en: My Chinese comes along very slowly.
It snowed today.
My school said: don't come in.
I was happy and drank tea at home.
In the afternoon I looked at the snow outside.

tokens.en: to look at; to read; to watch

sentences.en: The snow was white and beautiful.
Yesterday a person called my name in front of the shop.

tokens.en: to be called; to call out

sentences.en: I didn't know him.
He said he was my classmate.
I said: sorry, I don't know you.
He said: that's all right.
My little sister is six and she's learning to write.
Her characters are big and slow.
She wrote the character for "person".
I said: very good!
She was delighted.
My dad drinks a lot of tea every day.
My mom says too much tea isn't good.
She tells him to drink water.
Dad says: water has no tea in it, it isn't tasty.
Mom isn't pleased.
My room isn't big.
Inside there's a table, a chair, and a lot of books.
The books are on the table and on the chair too.
My cat sleeps on the books.
I like my room a lot.
Yesterday our family went to a new restaurant.
There were a lot of people at that restaurant.
We sat for twenty minutes.
The food was tasty, but expensive.
Dad said tomorrow we eat at home.

passages.title: 老人和狗
passages.title_en: The Old Man and the Dog

sentences.en: An old man lives in front of my house.
He has a white dog.
Every morning they walk out front.
He walks slowly, and the dog walks slowly too.

sentences.en: I want a cat.
I ask my mom every day.
She says: a cat needs food and time.
I said: I have time!
Tomorrow we're going to look at cats.

sentences.en: I've studied Chinese for a year.
Now I can say a lot.
But Chinese people speak fast.
When they talk I don't understand.
The teacher says: listen every day.
Today my classmate didn't come to school.
The teacher said he was sick.
In the afternoon I went to his house to see him.

tokens.en: to look at; to read; to watch

sentences.en: He was in his room watching TV.

sentences.en: He said: I'm fine, I just don't want to take the test.
The shop has big apples and small apples.
The big apples are expensive; the small ones are cheap.
I bought a lot of small apples.
On the way home I ate three.
Small apples are tasty too.
My cat loves fish.
When I buy fish she's delighted.
Today I bought a big fish.
The whole time I was cooking she was behind me.
The fish was tasty, and she said so too.
My dad is fifty and my mom is forty-eight.
Dad is tall; mom isn't.
They both work at a school.
On Sunday they watch TV at home.

tokens.en: to look at; to read; to watch

sentences.en: I love them very much.
This morning I was tired when I got up.
I looked at my watch.

tokens.en: to look at; to read; to watch

sentences.en: The watch said seven o'clock.
My phone said nine!
I didn't have time for tea.
I have a Chinese friend named Xiao Hong.

sentences.en: She studies at our school.
Every week we talk for an hour.
She learns my language and I learn Chinese.
We're both very happy.
Today I didn't do my work.
I watched TV and slept a long time.

Tomorrow I'll say "tomorrow" too.
